questions.html:
Consider the following statements regarding OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) and OLTP
(Online Transaction Processing) in data warehousing:
S1 : OLAP is used for decision support and data analysis based on historical data.
S2 : OLTP ensures data integrity and consistency across operational systems.
S3 : OLAP databases are optimized for fast transaction processing and real-time updates.
S4 : OLTP databases are typically denormalized to improve query performance.
Which of the following is/are true?
questions.solution:
(a)
• OLAP is indeed used for decision support and analysis based on historical data. So, S1 is true
• OLTP ensures data integrity and consistency across operational systems. So, S2 is true
• OLAP databases are not optimized for fast transaction processing and real-time updates; that is the role of OLTP. So, S3 is false
• OLTP databases are typically normalized, not denormalized, to maintain data integrity and reduce redundancy. S4 is false

questions.tags: Technical • Data Science and artificial Intelligence • +2 / -0.66
questions.html: Which of the following is a characteristic of OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) systems in data warehousing?

options.html: OLAP is designed for high throughput and low-latency transaction processing.
OLAP databases use denormalized data models to improve query performance.
OLAP is used primarily for maintaining current operational data.
OLAP supports complex querying and multidimensional analysis for business intelligence.

questions.solution:
(d)
• OLAP is not designed for transaction processing; OLTP systems handle transactional data with high throughput and low latency.
• OLAP databases may use denormalized data models for performance reasons, but this is not a defining characteristic.
• OLAP does not focus on maintaining current operational data; OLTP, systems are designed for operational data management.
• OLAP systems provide capabilities for complex querying and multidimensional analysis, which are essential for business intelligence and decision support.

questions.html: Consider relation R(A, B, C, D, E, F, G) with the following functional dependencies AB → CD,D → B, AF → D, DE → F, C → G, F → E and G → A. What is the highest normal form?
questions.solution:
(c)
Candidate keys: ABE, BEG, BCE, AF, FG, ADE etc. since all attribute are prime attribute. So, neither (prime → non-prime) nor (non-prime → non-prime) possible, so relation is always in 2NF as well as in 3NF. But since (candidate → anything), not present, so not in BCNF and highest normal form is 3NF.

questions.tags: Technical • Data Science and artificial Intelligence • +2 / -0
questions.html: Which of the following statements is/are correct?

options.html: Binning without dependence on class labels or predefined threshold is classified as unsupervised discretization.
Discretization by Binning consist of partitioning a continuous attribute into bins of equal width or frequency.
Discretization by histogram analysis uses histogram bins to discretize continuous data based on frequency distribution.
Discretization by histogram analysis always result in bins of equal width.

questions.solution:
(a, b, c)
(a) Binning without dependence on class labels or predefined thresholds is indeed classified as unsupervised discretization. This technique focuses on dividing data based on statistical measures rather than predefined categories. So, option (a) is correct.
(b) Discretization by Binning involves partitioning a continuous attribute into bins, which can be of equal width or frequency. This allows continuous data to be transformed into categorical or ordinal data. So, option (b) is correct.
(c) Discretization by Histogram analysis does use histogram bins to discretize continuous data based on its frequency distribution. Histogram bins are intervals that group data points based on their occurrence within specific value ranges. So, option (c) is correct.
(d) Discretization by Histogram analysis does not always result in bins of equal width. The width of histogram bins varies based on the data distribution and how the bins are defined to accurately represent the data's frequency distribution. So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.html:
Consider the following statement about hierarchies in data warehouse:

Which of the above is correct?

options.html: A roll-up operation moves from a higher level of to a lower level.
Hierarchies facilitate efficient data navigation and analysis at different aggregation levels.
Star schema do not support hierarchical data structure.
Hierarchical structures can improve query performance in data warehouse.

questions.solution:
(b, d)
(a) A roll-up operation moves from a lower level of granularity to a higher level, aggregating the data. So, option (a) is incorrect.
(b) Hierarchies facilitate efficient data navigation and analysis by organized data into level or tiers allow user to drill down or drill up to different levels of details as needed. So, option (b) is correct.
(c) Star schema do support hierarchical data structure although they are less normalized compared to snowflake schema. So, option (c) is incorrect.
(d) Hierarchical structures can improve query performance in data warehouse by organized data efficient for analysis. So, option (d) is correct.
